Fictitious Persons, Universities, Bands & Entities Disclaimer: All narrative characters, bands (including The Stardust Engine, Fractured Prisms, Crimson Node, The Paper Wall, Mana Canvas, The Arctic Symphony Project, and Teller County), biographies, universities (including Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute / CPI, Virginia Dominion University / VDU, The Forgers, The Crucible, Eleanor Bennett Commonwealth Hall, Callahan Hall, and Kincaid Commons), corporations (including OmniCorp, Vectron Energy Corp., Apex Records, Prairie Coachworks, and Sainte-Claire), transit agencies (Coastal Virginia Transit Authority / CVTA, Blue Ridge Transit, Radford Transit, and Mountain Valley Transit), in-universe administrative correspondence, legal filings, and any entity with “LLC”, “Trust”, or “Holdings” in its name (including Engine Room Records, LLC, The O'Connell Family, LLC, Artists First Management, LLC, Stardust Properties, LLC, Stardust Blacksburg, LLC, Stardust Strategic Assets, LLC, Pacific Rim Properties, LLC, Jessica Miller Center, LLC, and Aethelgard Holdings, LLC) are 100% works of fiction inside the RaggieSoft universe. Any resemblance to actual persons (living or dead), universities, businesses, institutions, or events is purely coincidental. In real life, there is only Engine Room Records (no “LLC”), the real-world creative brand under which Michael P. Ragsdale distributes his music.
